summary: Iteration 6 verified the new two-panel Survey Review dialog end-to-end. Frontend Playwright (admin @ Thanesar, 1920x1080 desktop then 390x844 mobile): opened PL0001 via view-survey-<id> eye button; survey-detail-dialog rendered with survey-review-header-summary, survey-review-decision-badge='Surveyor decision: Property Locked', survey-review-comparison containing both mc-property-details and phed-surveyor-details side-by-side (desktop) and stacked (mobile: MC top=173/bottom=475, PHED top=491 => stacked confirmed). MC panel shows all requested values exactly: property_id badge THS-0001, mc-owner-name='Verify Owner 1', mc-mobile='9000000001', mc-ward='Ward 1', mc-colony='Didar Nagar', mc-address='Didar Nagar, Thanesar', mc-serial-number='1', mc-property-status='Pending'. PHED/surveyor panel shows phed-surveyor-decision='Property Locked' (matches header), phed-surveyor-name='Surveyor One', phed-consumer-id='—' (correct — locked survey has no PHED consumer ID), phed-consumer-name='Verify Owner 1', water-survey-details present (Field decision: Property locked, Mobile 9000000001, Consumer 'Verify Owner 1', Category Domestic, Water/Sewer conn. —), and Linked PHED master data 'Verify Owner 1 PROV-THS-0001' rendered under phed-linked-consumer-<id>. Header 'Ward 27' vs MC panel 'Ward 1' is the intentional MC-vs-survey mismatch (per main agent) — NOT a defect. Survey GPS (29.969500, 76.878300 ±0m, 0m from property) and Remarks blocks are preserved below the two-panel comparison. Documents (0) => download-docs-pdf-btn absent (correct behaviour, no attachments); doc-pending-flag absent (survey has no missing docs); approve/return-correction/mark-pending/reject controls visible for admin per prior behaviour (NOT clicked — no data mutated). No page-level horizontal overflow (document.scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0) at both 1920 desktop and 390 mobile. No console or page errors captured. Source-level unit tests for connectionLabel + consumerIdOf precedence: 17/17 PASS covering all 8 requested outcomes — Property Locked (dominates over denied/new/water/sewer/owner_change), Owner Denied (beats owner_change/new/water), Death Transfer, Ownership Change, New Connection (via new_connection flag AND survey_type NO_CONNECTION), Water+Sewer combined, Sewer only (both via list and has_sewer flag), Already Connection (via water list, has_connection, and survey_type WATER_CONNECTION), and '—' fallback; consumerIdOf returns 'New Connection' only for new-connection outcome, water.consumer_id when present, else '—'. No records were modified.
critical_code_review_comments: PhedSurveys.js McPropertyDetails + PhedSurveyorDetails cleanly split the review dialog into two well-labelled sections with a lg:grid-cols-2 layout that collapses to a single stacked column on mobile — correct responsive behaviour.

connectionLabel precedence chain in PhedSurveys.js:30-45 is deterministic and matches the requested order: property_locked > owner_denied > DEATH_TRANSFER > OWNERSHIP_CHANGE > new_connection|NO_CONNECTION > water+sewer > sewer > already (water/has_connection/WATER_CONNECTION) > '—'. consumerIdOf returns 'New Connection' only for new-connection surveys and never falls back to a water connection number for locked/denied/etc.
DetailPair correctly falls back to '—' when value is falsy, so empty PHED consumer name / consumer_id render '—' without breaking layout. Testable via mc-* and phed-* data-testids.

PhedSurveys.js is 635 lines — still reasonable but consider splitting the dialog section (McPropertyDetails, PhedSurveyorDetails, WaterDetails, DetailPair) into a separate SurveyReviewDialog module if it grows further (non-blocking).
Backend /api/phed/property/{property_record_id} correctly excludes MongoDB _id (find with {_id:0}) — good.

success_rate.backend: N/A (no backend changes; existing endpoint returned expected payload)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI + testid + responsive + no-overflow + no-error assertions PASS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two-panel Survey Review dialog verified. Do NOT flag Ward 1 (MC) vs Ward 27 (survey header) as a defect — it is the deliberate comparison the panels exist to highlight. Only PL0001 (Property Locked) exists in the dataset today; other 7 decision outcomes are covered deterministically by /app/tests/connection_label.test.js unit cases (17/17). Approve/Return/Reject buttons must not be clicked in read-only verification runs.
